Text: Saints' man becomes first person to swim around St Helena
A local St Helena man has become the first person to ever swim around the island of St Helena.

Ryan Donalds completed the circumnavigation swim of St Helena, covering a distance of approximately 53 miles, over a period of 8 days.

Ryan completed the final stretch of the swim at Jamestown on Sunday 8 February 2026.

**Ryan Donalds** became the first person to swim around Saint Helena island. He completed the circumnavigation swim of approximately 53 miles over 8 days, finishing at Jamestown on Sunday, 8 February 2026.
